---
title: "Data Cleaning + EDA"
format: html
---
This dataset has been cleaned and filtered to only include auctions from 2006 and later. The dataset includes information on auction prices, dates, and other relevant features. We also have a separate dataset containing transaction information, which we will join with the auction data for further analysis.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
auctions <- read.csv("df_for_ml_improved_up_to_2012.csv")
transactions <- read.csv("transactions.csv")

auctions <- auctions |>
    left_join(transactions, by = "case_id") |>
    filter(year >=2006)

write_csv(auctions, "joined_auctions_transactions.csv")
```


The complete dataset, composed of the two joined tables, contains 24391 observations and 149 variables. 
```{r}
# Clean the joined auction dataset (Lee et al. 2024, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.24746268)
#
# Outputs (in out_dir):
#   auctions_clean.csv   one cleaned table
#   data_dictionary.md   what every column means
#
# Run in RStudio / a Quarto chunk (set the paths below), or from a terminal:
#   Rscript clean_auctions.R joined_auctions_transactions.csv [out_dir]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

in_path <- "joined_auctions_transactions.csv"
out_dir <- "."

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (!interactive() && !isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress")) && length(args) >= 1) {
  in_path <- args[1]
  if (length(args) >= 2) out_dir <- args[2]
}
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MAX_SIDE_IN  <- 300    # sides above this are flagged as likely unit errors
PREMIUM_RATE <- 0.20   # assumed buyer's premium added to hammer prices in price_adj_usd

# Genre codes inferred from known artists and lot titles (not documented by the authors)
GENRE_LABELS <- c(`1` = "Painting", `2` = "Photograph", `3` = "Drawing",
                  `4` = "Print", `5` = "Sculpture", `6` = "Other")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column spec: the single source of truth for names, order and documentation.
#   name    final column name
#   from    source column to rename (NA = computed below)
#   section heading in the dictionary
#   use     id | target | feature | estimate | LEAK | flag | info
#   desc    meaning
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
spec <- tribble(
  ~name, ~from, ~section, ~use, ~desc,
  # IDs ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  "row_id", "case_id", "Identifiers", "id", "Unique row ID (source `case_id`).",
  "artist_id", "sales_id", "Identifiers", "id", "Artist ID, one value per artist (source `sales_id`, despite the name). Use for grouped CV or random effects.",
  "lot_id", "lot_num", "Identifiers", "id", "Lot page ID on the source website (source `lot_num`).",
  "lot_no", NA, "Identifiers", "info", "Lot number within the sale (from text like 'Lot 227').",
  "is_train", "train", "Identifiers", "id", "Authors' split: 1 = train (sales 2006-2011), 0 = test (2011-2012). Time-based; don't reshuffle.",

  # Sale ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  "sale_date", NA, "Sale", "feature", "Auction date.",
  "sale_year", "year", "Sale", "feature", "Auction year.",
  "sale_month", NA, "Sale", "feature", "Auction month (1-12).",
  "sale_name", "event.name", "Sale", "info", "Name of the auction event.",
  "house", "auction_house", "Sale", "feature", "Auction house name.",
  "house_tier", NA, "Sale", "feature", "Auction house tier, 1 (top: Christie's, Sotheby's, Phillips) to 4, by market dominance and reputation.",
  "sale_country", NA, "Sale", "feature", "Country of sale, grouped (largest markets + 'Others').",
  "sale_country_raw", "country", "Sale", "info", "Country of sale as recorded (ungrouped).",
  "sale_continent", NA, "Sale", "feature", "Continent of sale.",
  "sale_currency", "currency", "Sale", "info", "Currency of the sale.",
  "is_hammer", NA, "Sale", "feature", "1 = recorded price is the hammer price (no buyer's premium); 0 = price includes premium.",

  # Price (targets) ------------------------------------------------------------
  "price_usd", "price_usd.x", "Price (targets)", "target", "Sale price, nominal USD. Mixes hammer and premium prices (see `is_hammer`).",
  "log_price", NA, "Price (targets)", "target", "Natural log of `price_usd`. Recommended target.",
  "price_real_usd", "real_price_usd", "Price (targets)", "target", "Sale price adjusted for inflation with `cpi`.",
  "log_price_real", NA, "Price (targets)", "target", "Natural log of `price_real_usd` (replaces the source's rounded `ln_real_price`).",
  "price_adj_usd", NA, "Price (targets)", "target", "`price_usd` with hammer prices raised by PREMIUM_RATE (default 20%), so all prices roughly include buyer's premium.",
  "log_price_adj", NA, "Price (targets)", "target", "Natural log of `price_adj_usd`.",
  "price_local", NA, "Price (targets)", "LEAK", "Sale price in the local currency (source `bidding_currency`).",
  "cpi", "cpi", "Price (targets)", "info", "Consumer price index used for `price_real_usd`.",

  # Pre-sale estimates -----------------------------------------------------------
  "est_low_usd", "estimate_min_usd", "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "Auction house's low estimate, USD.",
  "est_high_usd", "estimate_max_usd", "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "High estimate, USD.",
  "est_mid_usd", "estimate_center_usd", "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "Midpoint of low and high estimates, USD.",
  "log_est_mid", NA, "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "Natural log of `est_mid_usd`.",
  "log10_est_geomean", "log10_estimate_geo_mean_usd", "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "log10 of the geometric mean of low and high estimates (source).",
  "est_range_usd", "estimate_range_usd", "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "High minus low estimate, USD.",
  "est_low_local", NA, "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "Low estimate in the local currency (`sale_currency`).",
  "est_high_local", NA, "Pre-sale estimates", "estimate", "High estimate in the local currency (`sale_currency`).",
  "in_est_range", NA, "Pre-sale estimates", "LEAK", "1 if the price fell within the estimate range (uses the price).",

  # Artwork ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  "title", "lot_title", "Artwork", "info", "Title of the work (HTML entities decoded).",
  "genre", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "Painting, Photograph, Drawing, Print, Sculpture (1 row) or Other. Decoded from the source's numeric code; labels inferred by us.",
  "materials", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "Materials code 1-17 from the source; no key published. Treat as categorical.",
  "height_in", "height.x", "Artwork", "feature", "Height, inches.",
  "width_in", "width.x", "Artwork", "feature", "Width, inches.",
  "area_sqin", "size_inchsqr", "Artwork", "feature", "Height x width, square inches.",
  "log_area", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "Natural log of `area_sqin`.",
  "aspect_ratio", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "Height / width.",
  "year_made", "year_of_artwork", "Artwork", "feature", "Year the work was made (about 6% missing).",
  "work_age", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "`sale_year - year_made`, in years (negative values set to NA).",
  "is_untitled", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "1 if titled Untitled / Sans titre / Senza titolo / Ohne Titel.",
  "is_multi_work", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "1 if the lot is a set, e.g. '[Two Works]'.",
  "has_provenance", NA, "Artwork", "feature", "1 if the lot listed any provenance.",
  "in_main_genre", "matched_genre", "Artwork", "feature", "1 if the work is in the artist's main genre.",
  "sold_in_home_country", "matched_country", "Artwork", "feature", "1 if sold in the artist's working country.",
  "image_url", NA, "Artwork", "info", "URL of the lot image (may no longer be live).",

  # Artist ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  "artist", "artist_name", "Artist", "feature", "Artist name. Use as a grouping variable, or target-encode within training folds only.",
  "artist_nationality", "nationality", "Artist", "feature", "Artist nationality.",
  "artist_living_country", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Country the artist lives in, grouped; 'unknown' where missing.",
  "artist_birth_year", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Birth year.",
  "artist_age", "age", "Artist", "feature", "Artist's age at the sale.",
  "artist_gender", NA, "Artist", "feature", "female / male / unknown.",
  "artist_edu_place", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Where the artist studied: domestic / abroad / both / unknown.",
  "artist_degree", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Highest degree: none / undergraduate / graduate / unknown.",
  "artist_elite_school", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Attended an elite art school: elite / non_elite / unknown.",
  "artist_elite_award", NA, "Artist", "feature", "Won an elite art award: received / not_received.",
  "artist_has_bio", NA, "Artist", "feature", "1 if a biography was available.",

  # Artist reputation -----------------------------------------------------------------
  "artist_rank", "ranking", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Global artist ranking at the time of sale (lower = more prominent), based on US and European sources.",
  "artist_n_solo", "solo_show", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Solo exhibitions up to the auction year.",
  "artist_n_group", "group_show", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Group exhibitions up to the auction year.",
  "artist_n_biennials", "fest_biennal", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Art fair / biennial participations.",
  "artist_n_private_acq", "private_inst", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Acquisitions by private collections.",
  "artist_n_museum_acq", "public_inst", "Artist reputation", "feature", "Acquisitions by museums / public institutions.",

  # Artist price history (safe) ---------------------------------------------------------
  "artist_sale_seq", "artwork_order", "Artist price history", "feature", "Position of this sale in the artist's full auction history.",
  "prev5_mean_usd", "price_usd_prev_5_mean", "Artist price history", "feature", "Mean price of the artist's previous 5 sales, USD.",
  "prev5_med_usd", "price_usd_prev_5_median", "Artist price history", "feature", "Median price, previous 5 sales.",
  "prev5_min_usd", "price_usd_prev_5_min", "Artist price history", "feature", "Minimum price, previous 5 sales.",
  "prev5_max_usd", "price_usd_prev_5_max", "Artist price history", "feature", "Maximum price, previous 5 sales.",
  "prev10_mean_usd", "price_usd_prev_10_mean", "Artist price history", "feature", "Mean price of the artist's previous 10 sales, USD.",
  "prev10_med_usd", "price_usd_prev_10_median", "Artist price history", "feature", "Median price, previous 10 sales.",
  "prev10_min_usd", "price_usd_prev_10_min", "Artist price history", "feature", "Minimum price, previous 10 sales.",
  "prev10_max_usd", "price_usd_prev_10_max", "Artist price history", "feature", "Maximum price, previous 10 sales.",
  "prev5_sizeadj_mean", "price_same_size_prev_5_mean", "Artist price history", "feature", "Mean of the previous 5 prices, standardized to this work's size (source; method not documented).",
  "prev5_sizeadj_med", "price_same_size_prev_5_median", "Artist price history", "feature", "Median, previous 5, size-standardized.",
  "prev5_sizeadj_min", "price_same_size_prev_5_min", "Artist price history", "feature", "Minimum, previous 5, size-standardized.",
  "prev5_sizeadj_max", "price_same_size_prev_5_max", "Artist price history", "feature", "Maximum, previous 5, size-standardized.",
  "prev10_sizeadj_mean", "price_same_size_prev_10_mean", "Artist price history", "feature", "Mean, previous 10, size-standardized.",
  "prev10_sizeadj_med", "price_same_size_prev_10_median", "Artist price history", "feature", "Median, previous 10, size-standardized.",
  "prev10_sizeadj_min", "price_same_size_prev_10_min", "Artist price history", "feature", "Minimum, previous 10, size-standardized.",
  "prev10_sizeadj_max", "price_same_size_prev_10_max", "Artist price history", "feature", "Maximum, previous 10, size-standardized.",
  "prior_n_sales", NA, "Artist price history", "feature", "Artist's sales in this file on earlier dates (computed here).",
  "prior_mean_log_price", NA, "Artist price history", "feature", "Mean `log_price` of the artist's sales on earlier dates; NA on their first date (computed here).",
  "prior_max_log_price", NA, "Artist price history", "feature", "Max `log_price` of the artist's sales on earlier dates (computed here).",

  # Same-year price stats (leak) ----------------------------------------------------------
  "yr_mean_ppsi", "meanprice_year", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's mean price per square inch in the sale year.",
  "yr_med_ppsi", "medianprice_year", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's median price per square inch in the sale year.",
  "yr_min_ppsi", "min_price", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's minimum price per square inch in the sale year.",
  "yr_max_ppsi", "max_price", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's maximum price per square inch in the sale year.",
  "ctry_yr_mean_ppsi", "cnt_mean", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's mean price per square inch in the sale country that year.",
  "ctry_yr_med_ppsi", "cnt_median", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, median.",
  "ctry_yr_min_ppsi", "cnt_min", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, minimum.",
  "ctry_yr_max_ppsi", "cnt_max", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, maximum.",
  "cont_yr_mean_ppsi", "cot_mean", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Artist's mean price per square inch on the sale continent that year.",
  "cont_yr_med_ppsi", "cot_median", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, median.",
  "cont_yr_min_ppsi", "cot_min", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, minimum.",
  "cont_yr_max_ppsi", "cot_max", "Same-year price stats", "LEAK", "Same, maximum.",

  # Data-quality flags --------------------------------------------------------------------
  "flag_size", NA, "Data-quality flags", "flag", "1 if height or width exceeds MAX_SIDE_IN (default 300 in); likely a unit error.",
  "flag_birth_record", NA, "Data-quality flags", "flag", "1 if the source birth field lists a death year for a living artist; artist details may be mismatched.",
  "flag_age", NA, "Data-quality flags", "flag", "1 if `artist_age` disagrees with `sale_year - artist_birth_year` by more than 1.",
  "flag_title_garbled", NA, "Data-quality flags", "flag", "1 if accented characters in the title were lost in the source (shown as '?').",
  "flag_year_made_missing", NA, "Data-quality flags", "flag", "1 if `year_made` is missing."
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
unescape_html <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace_all(c("&#0?39;" = "'", "&#0?34;" = "\"", "&quot;" = "\"",
                      "&lt;" = "<", "&gt;" = ">", "&amp;" = "&")) |>
    str_squish()
}

# Collapse a block of 0/1 columns into one factor; rows with no flag set -> "unknown"
collapse_onehot <- function(df, labels) {
  m <- df |> select(all_of(names(labels))) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), \(v) replace_na(v, 0))) |> as.matrix()
  n_set <- rowSums(m)
  if (any(n_set > 1)) stop("More than one flag set in block starting ", names(labels)[1])
  out <- unname(labels[max.col(m, ties.method = "first")])
  out[n_set == 0] <- "unknown"
  factor(out)
}

prefix_labels <- function(df, prefix) {
  cols   <- names(df)[startsWith(names(df), prefix)]
  labels <- str_replace_all(str_remove(cols, fixed(prefix)), fixed("."), " ")
  labels <- recode(labels, Dutch = "Netherlands", Swiss = "Switzerland", Italia = "Italy")
  set_names(labels, cols)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
raw <- read_csv(in_path,
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),   # file is not UTF-8
                name_repair = "minimal",                # keep names like Tier...1
                guess_max = 30000, show_col_types = FALSE,
                col_types = cols(Year.of.Birth = col_character(),
                                 estimate_min = col_character(), estimate_max = col_character(),
                                 bidding_currency = col_character()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build new columns
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
untitled_rx <- regex("untitled|sans titre|senza titolo|ohne titel", ignore_case = TRUE)
multi_rx    <- regex("\\[\\s*\\w+ works\\]|\\(\\s*\\w+ works\\)", ignore_case = TRUE)

onehots <- list(
  house_tier            = prefix_labels(raw, "Tier..."),
  sale_country          = prefix_labels(raw, "Country..."),
  sale_continent        = prefix_labels(raw, "Continent..."),
  artist_living_country = prefix_labels(raw, "Living..."),
  artist_gender         = c(gender_female = "female", gender_male = "male", gender_NA = "unknown"),
  artist_edu_place      = c(edu_domestic = "domestic", edu_abroad = "abroad", edu_both = "both", edu_NA = "unknown"),
  artist_degree         = c(no_degree = "none", undergrad = "undergraduate", grad = "graduate", degree_NA = "unknown"),
  artist_elite_school   = c(elite_school = "elite", non_elite_school = "non_elite", elite_school_NA = "unknown"),
  artist_elite_award    = c(elite_award_received = "received", elite_award_not_received = "not_received")
)

df <- raw |>
  mutate(across(c(artist_name, lot_title, auction_house, event.name, nationality, country, provenance),
                unescape_html))

for (new in names(onehots)) df[[new]] <- collapse_onehot(df, onehots[[new]])

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    # sale
    sale_date  = ymd(eventdate),
    sale_month = month(sale_date),
    lot_no     = as.integer(str_extract(lot, "\\d+")),
    is_hammer  = as.integer(Ham_Prem == "Hammer"),

    # price
    log_price      = log(price_usd.x),
    log_price_real = log(real_price_usd),
    price_adj_usd  = if_else(is_hammer == 1, price_usd.x * (1 + PREMIUM_RATE), as.numeric(price_usd.x)),
    log_price_adj  = log(price_adj_usd),
    price_local    = parse_number(bidding_currency),

    # estimates
    log_est_mid    = log(estimate_center_usd),
    est_low_local  = parse_number(estimate_min),
    est_high_local = parse_number(estimate_max),
    in_est_range   = as.integer(price_usd.x >= estimate_min_usd & price_usd.x <= estimate_max_usd),

    # artwork
    genre          = factor(unname(GENRE_LABELS[as.character(genre)]), levels = unname(GENRE_LABELS)),
    materials      = factor(materials),
    log_area       = log(size_inchsqr),
    aspect_ratio   = height.x / width.x,
    work_age       = if_else(year - year_of_artwork < 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(year - year_of_artwork)),
    is_untitled    = as.integer(str_detect(replace_na(lot_title, ""), untitled_rx)),
    is_multi_work  = as.integer(str_detect(replace_na(lot_title, ""), multi_rx)),
    has_provenance = as.integer(!is.na(provenance)),
    image_url      = str_match(img_link, 'src="([^"]+)"')[, 2],

    # artist
    artist_birth_year = as.integer(str_extract(Year.of.Birth, "\\d{4}")),
    artist_has_bio    = as.integer(biography == "Y"),

    # flags
    flag_size              = as.integer(height.x > MAX_SIDE_IN | width.x > MAX_SIDE_IN),
    flag_birth_record      = as.integer(str_detect(replace_na(Year.of.Birth, ""), fixed("d."))),
    flag_age               = as.integer(replace_na(abs(year - artist_birth_year - age) > 1, FALSE)),
    flag_title_garbled     = as.integer(str_detect(replace_na(lot_title, ""), fixed("?"))),
    flag_year_made_missing = as.integer(is.na(year_of_artwork))
  )

# Leakage-safe artist history: only sales on EARLIER dates
history <- df |>
  group_by(artist_name, sale_date) |>
  summarise(day_sum = sum(log_price), day_n = n(), day_max = max(log_price), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(artist_name, sale_date) |>
  group_by(artist_name) |>
  mutate(prior_n_sales        = cumsum(day_n) - day_n,
         prior_mean_log_price = (cumsum(day_sum) - day_sum) / na_if(prior_n_sales, 0),
         prior_max_log_price  = lag(cummax(day_max))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(artist_name, sale_date, starts_with("prior_"))

df <- left_join(df, history, by = c("artist_name", "sale_date"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rename and keep exactly the columns in the spec, in spec order
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
renames <- spec |> filter(!is.na(from)) |> select(name, from) |> deframe()
missing_src <- setdiff(renames, names(df))
if (length(missing_src)) stop("Source columns not found: ", str_c(missing_src, collapse = ", "))

clean <- df |>
  rename(all_of(renames)) |>
  select(all_of(spec$name)) |>
  arrange(sale_date, row_id)

write_csv(clean, file.path(out_dir, "auctions_clean.csv"), na = "")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data dictionary (Markdown)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
col_type <- function(v) {
  if (is.factor(v)) "category" else if (inherits(v, "Date")) "date"
  else if (is.character(v)) "text"
  else if (all(v %in% c(0, 1, NA))) "0/1"
  else if (is.numeric(v) && all(v == round(v), na.rm = TRUE)) "integer"
  else "number"
}

dict <- spec |>
  mutate(type    = map_chr(name, \(n) col_type(clean[[n]])),
         missing = map_dbl(name, \(n) mean(is.na(clean[[n]]))),
         missing = case_when(missing == 0 ~ "", missing < 0.001 ~ "<0.1%",
                             TRUE ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * missing)),
         values  = map_chr(name, \(n) {
           v <- clean[[n]]
           if (is.factor(v)) str_c(levels(v), collapse = ", ") else ""
         }),
         desc = if_else(!name %in% c("sale_country", "sale_continent", "artist_living_country"), desc,
                        str_c(desc, " Values: ", values, ".")))

n_flag <- \(col) format(sum(clean[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")

md <- c(
  "# Data dictionary: auctions_clean.csv", "",
  str_glue("{format(nrow(clean), big.mark = ',')} auction sales of works by {n_distinct(clean$artist)} living contemporary artists, ",
           "{min(clean$sale_year)}-{max(clean$sale_year)}, {ncol(clean)} columns. ",
           "Source: Lee et al. (2024), *Scientific Reports*, data at doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24746268."),
  "",
  "## How to use the columns", "",
  "The **Use** column tells you what each variable is safe for:", "",
  "- **target**: a version of the sale price. Pick one to predict; never use one as an input.",
  "- **LEAK**: contains this sale's price (directly or inside a same-year average). Never use as a feature.",
  "- **estimate**: the auction house's pre-sale estimate. Known before the sale, but it nearly determines the price, so compare models with and without it.",
  "- **feature**: safe model input.",
  "- **flag**: data-quality marker (1 = problem). Use to filter, or as a feature.",
  "- **id** / **info**: identifiers and descriptive text, not model inputs.",
  "",
  str_glue("**Never use as model inputs:** {str_c('`', spec$name[spec$use %in% c('target', 'LEAK')], '`', collapse = ', ')}."),
  "",
  "Abbreviations: **ppsi** = price per square inch (inflation-adjusted USD); **prev5 / prev10** = the artist's previous 5 / 10 sales; **ctry / cont / yr** = country / continent / year.",
  "",
  "## Data notes", "",
  str_glue("- **Genre labels are inferred.** The source stores genre as codes 1-6 and does not document them. We matched them using known artists (e.g. Cindy Sherman's works are all code 2 = Photograph; Jasper Johns' are mostly 4 = Print). The source's one-hot genre columns had the wrong names and were dropped."),
  str_glue("- **Prices mix hammer and premium.** {round(100 * mean(clean$is_hammer))}% of prices exclude the buyer's premium; `price_adj_usd` puts them on a common footing using an assumed {PREMIUM_RATE * 100}% premium."),
  str_glue("- **Split:** `is_train` is the authors' time-based split ({format(sum(clean$is_train), big.mark = ',')} train / {format(sum(clean$is_train == 0), big.mark = ',')} test)."),
  str_glue("- **Flags:** {n_flag('flag_size')} rows with an implausible size, {n_flag('flag_birth_record')} with a suspect birth record, {n_flag('flag_age')} with an inconsistent age, {n_flag('flag_title_garbled')} with garbled titles. Flagged rows are kept."),
  "- **Same-year price stats leak.** They are computed over all of the artist's sales that year, including this one: for artists with a single sale in a year, the yearly mean usually equals that sale's own price per square inch, and every sale falls inside its yearly min-max. Use the `prev*` and `prior_*` columns instead.",
  "- **Dropped from the source:** duplicate columns from the join (`.y` copies, `event_year`, `event.date`, `est_currency`), empty columns (`artfacts_id`, `alive_id`, `depth`), prices in EUR/GBP, price per inch, raw HTML, and all one-hot blocks (now single category columns)."
)

for (sec in unique(dict$section)) {
  sub <- filter(dict, section == sec)
  md <- c(md, "", str_glue("## {sec}"), "",
          "| Column | Use | Type | Missing | Description |",
          "|---|---|---|---|---|",
          str_glue_data(sub, "| `{name}` | {use} | {type} | {missing} | {desc} |"))
}
write_lines(md, file.path(out_dir, "data_dictionary.md"))

message("Wrote ", nrow(clean), " rows x ", ncol(clean), " columns to ", file.path(out_dir, "auctions_clean.csv"),
        "\nWrote ", file.path(out_dir, "data_dictionary.md"))
```
